free_text: I defer biopsy because the mpMRI demonstrated a PI-RADS 2 finding, which falls below the EAU threshold of 3 for biopsy. This conclusion is strongly supported by the EXPERT-COHORT criterion, which matched the reading urologist in 24 of 24 cases with PI-RADS 1-2 lesions. The Registrar confirmed the PI-RADS 2 finding and noted no higher-risk lesions, which aligns with the guideline and cohort data.
